name: Eswatini

validation.referee: statute's own printed tables and amounts (Lean #guard / decide)
validation.notes: build phase: no referee values used

sources: Income Tax Order 1975 updated to the Amendment Acts 2011 and 2013 (ERS): s. 2 (6), 8, 12 (1) (qq), Third Schedule
Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2023 (Act 20 of 2023) s. 1 (2), 39 (ERS; scanned, OCR'd, table checked on the image)
registry_correction: SZ: Income Tax Order 1975 (as amended; Act 20 of 2023 replaced the Third Schedule): 20/25/30/33 %, rebate E8 200 (+E2 700 over 60), dividends and interest 10 %; year ending 30 June.
headline: Eswatini built from the Income Tax Order 1975 and Act 20 of 2023: 20-33 % with an E8 200 rebate (tax starts above E41 000); the 2023 rate table stops at E250 000 and is dated to the year ending 30 June 2023.

w5_pattern_a.added: ENPF employee 5 % of wages up to E4,000 / month (2025) and E4,300 (2026); deducted (s. 14 (1) (i))
w5_pattern_a.provision: ENPF (Statutory Contributions) Regulations 2025 (LN 5/2025) reg. 2 (1) (a)-(b), as reproduced by the Fund; rate 5 % + 5 % (Fund notice); Income Tax Order s. 2 "pension fund", s. 14 (1) (i), Fourth Schedule para 2 (4)
w5_pattern_a.switch: "w5Contrib": false restores the pre-W5 outputs (0 / 300 random households differ)

d9_review.change: ENPF caps per calendar month (5 % x (min(w,48000)+min(w,51600))/2); was one annual cap of 49,800
d9_review.switch: "szEnpfAnnualCap": true restores the old rule (0 / 300 random households differ)
